name: prompt-pal
title: Prompt Pal - Teaching/Learning
summary: A prompt library and coaching partner for everyday course and teaching design work.
description: Prompt Pal is an interactive chat tool that helps faculty and learning designers write better AI prompts. Ask for ready-made prompts for common tasks — learning objectives, rubrics, learning activities, accessibility checks, AI use policies — or paste your own draft and get coached on improving it. Every request returns a basic version, an enhanced version built with the PROMPT framework (Persona, Requirements, Organization, Medium, Purpose, Tone), and a CLEAR check (Concise, Logical, Explicit, Adaptive, Reflective). It only writes and refines prompts — you copy the result into Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI tool to actually run it.
examples: I need a prompt for writing learning objectives for a course on operations strategy.
Here is a draft prompt I wrote — can you coach me on improving it?
I need a prompt for creating an AI use policy for my course syllabus.
author: Office of Instructional Innovation, McCombs School of Business
